correctness.rationale: Feng (2026) supplies exact rational Betti ranks 233 and 28 and concentration in degrees six and nine. Feng–Wang (2024), Theorem 10, supplies 28 linearly independent six-set cross-polytope ninth-homology generators. Their stabilizer representation is sign on the six elements, established by the explicitly verified transposition on ten antipodal axes. For each of 22 S8 conjugacy classes, invariant simplices are precisely independent collections of admissible triple-orbits, giving reduced Lefschetz trace minus the independence polynomial at minus one. Exact deletion recurrence and full Murnaghan–Nakayama character orthogonality give nine multiplicity-one constituents in degree six, two in degree nine, with dimensions 233 and 28. Verified standalone artifact verify.py contains these exhaustive finite steps. No inference of integral homotopy from rank data.

value.rationale: Feng (2026) left the 233-dimensional degree-six module opaque despite motivating a combinatorial basis. Computing its full natural S8 action is a precise structural gap: the rank splits into nine distinct irreducible Specht constituents each once, including exactly one trivial and one alternating-sign line. These features are not implied by Betti numbers or by the known seven-point representation, and inform equivariant quotient homology and symmetry-sensitive cycle constructions. This natural first eight-point case is not an arbitrary unmotivated parameter slice.
